reuse.why: Adds a shared getRangeAmount and routes getScheduledAmount through it, but the five server sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range arithmetic is now defined once, but the `== null ? 0 : number ? v : range` dispatch that getScheduledAmount already implements stays copied in updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, normalizeSchedule and createScheduleList.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, where both server and client read schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, their comments, a test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule itself changes in one place; the remaining per-site dispatch is a smaller hazard if missing or single amounts ever change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and schedule-template.ts createScheduleList keep their own dispatch around getRangeAmount instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The retained per-site dispatches are pre-existing copies left in place, not reshaped by this diff.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getRangeAmount, used by getScheduledAmount (client) and every server path (schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedule-template.ts, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions).
